mapper.select: SELECT plan_id AS id, plan_name AS planName, major_id AS majorId, grade, version, total_required_credits AS totalRequiredCredits, major_elective_min_credits AS majorElectiveMinCredits, general_elective_min_credits AS generalElectiveMinCredits, plan_status AS planStatus, plan_deleted AS planDeleted, plan_remark AS planRemark, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, gmt_modified AS gmtModified FROM edu_training_plan WHERE major_id = #{majorId} AND grade = #{grade} AND plan_status = 1 AND plan_deleted = 0 ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.plan_id AS id, p.plan_name AS planName, p.major_id AS majorId, m.major_name AS majorName, p.grade, p.version, p.total_required_credits AS totalRequiredCredits, p.major_elective_min_credits AS majorElectiveMinCredits, p.general_elective_min_credits AS generalElectiveMinCredits, p.plan_status AS planStatus, p.plan_remark AS planRemark, p.gmt_create AS gmtCreate, p.gmt_modified AS gmtModified FROM edu_training_plan p LEFT JOIN edu_major m ON p.major_id = m.major_id AND m.major_deleted = 0 WHERE p.plan_id = #{planId} AND p.plan_deleted = 0
